description: This script generates C++ source and header files containing font overlay data for the ANGLE project. It processes a monospace font file to produce bitmap representations of ASCII characters in a fixed grid, outputting C++ arrays and functions for rendering overlay fonts.

classes.name: Face
classes.description: Freetype font face object used to load and render font characters.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that generates font data arrays and writes output files based on font rendering.
